# CellPay

> Pay or refill a US prepaid phone plan online with just the phone number, no carrier login. 15+ carriers, in English and Spanish. Service fee shown before you pay.

CellPay is an independent payment service. Pay with the 10-digit number, no carrier login, for yourself or someone else. Service fee shown before you pay. Payment methods: card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Klarna, Cash App or Pay by Bank.

Supported carriers include AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, Cricket, Metro by T-Mobile, Boost Mobile, Straight Talk, TracFone, Total Wireless, H2O, Lyca, Net10, Page Plus, Simple Mobile, and Ultra Mobile. Each carrier page is available in English and Spanish (add /es before the path).

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.cellpay.us/): Browse all supported prepaid carriers and start a refill.
- [About Us](https://www.cellpay.us/about-us): What CellPay is and the carriers it serves.
- [How to Use](https://www.cellpay.us/how-to-use): Step-by-step guide to recharging a prepaid line.
- [FAQ](https://www.cellpay.us/faq): Common questions about refills, payments, and delivery times.
- [Contact Us](https://www.cellpay.us/contact-us): Email support and business hours.

## Carriers

- [AT&T PrePaid](https://www.cellpay.us/topup-at.html): Refill AT&T PrePaid plans and add-ons.
- [AT&T FirstNet](https://www.cellpay.us/att-firstnet): Pay AT&T FirstNet prepaid plans.
- [T-Mobile Prepaid](https://www.cellpay.us/tmobile-flexi.html): T-Mobile prepaid refills and plans.
- [Verizon Prepaid bill pay](https://www.cellpay.us/verizon): Pay a Verizon Prepaid bill with the phone number, no login.
- [Verizon Prepaid refill](https://www.cellpay.us/verizon-wireless-flexi.html): Verizon prepaid plan refills.
- [Metro by T-Mobile](https://www.cellpay.us/metropcs.html): Metro by T-Mobile monthly plan payments.
- [Cricket Wireless](https://www.cellpay.us/topup-crc.html): Cricket prepaid plan refills.
- [Boost Mobile](https://www.cellpay.us/boost.html): Boost Mobile prepaid refills.
- [Straight Talk](https://www.cellpay.us/straight-talk.html): Straight Talk service plan refills.
- [TracFone](https://www.cellpay.us/tracfone.html): TracFone airtime and plan refills.
- [Total Wireless](https://www.cellpay.us/total-wireless): Total Wireless plan payments.
- [Simple Mobile](https://www.cellpay.us/s1.html): Simple Mobile bill pay and plan refills.
- [H2O Wireless](https://www.cellpay.us/h2o.html): H2O prepaid plan refills.
- [Lyca Mobile](https://www.cellpay.us/lyca.html): Lyca Mobile prepaid plan refills.
- [Net10](https://www.cellpay.us/net10.html): Net10 Wireless prepaid refills.
- [Page Plus](https://www.cellpay.us/pageplus.html): Page Plus Cellular prepaid refills.
- [Ultra Mobile](https://www.cellpay.us/ultra-mobile.html): Ultra Mobile prepaid plan refills.
